question: Not rice, maize at sowing stage.
answer:
From the Kamrup, Assam bulletin issued 2026-09-11, for maize:

MAIZE · Sowing · page 2:
“For Rabi maize optimum time of sowing is mid of September to mid of October. Therefore, farmers are suggested to select hybrid or composite variety for cultivation. Well drained sandy loam soil is most preferable for maize cultivation. Plough the field thoroughly to obtain deep, fine and firm tilth. Laddering should be done properly for leveling a well as to conserve soil moisture.”

Context from the same bulletin edition follows. These are separate source sections, not crop-specific matches or verified current official warnings. Printed warning dates and conditions are preserved; bulletin forecast dates do not extend their validity.

Forecast Summary: · page 1:
“Forecast received from Regional Meteorological Centre (RMC), Guwahati for the coming five days stated that the weather will be partly cloudy sky with possibility of getting light to moderate rainfall. Moreover, temperature will be high in day time and night time and weather will be wet in condition. Moreover, Extended range forecast (ERFS) received from IMD suggests that rainfall, maximum and minimum temperature will normal over Assam-Meghalaya region during 13th September to 19th September, 2026.”

Weather Warnings (Valid Till 08:30 IST of the next day) · page 1:
“During the five days from 12.09.2026 to 16.09.2026 thunderstorms, lightning and squall may be observed in the district and except 15.09.2026.”

Likely impacts of weather warnings on Agriculture and associated Agromet advisories · page 1:
“NA”

General Advisory: · page 1:
“Due to rise of air temperature use ORS (Oral rehydration solution), homemade drink like lassi, lemmon water, buttermilk etc to keep yourself hydrated.”

SMS Advisory: · page 2:
“Those farmers who used to cultivate the winter vegetables regularly at the same place are advised to test their soil before the winter vegetables is grown.”

Likely impacts of weather warnings (General) · page 2:
“NA”

Impact based advisories (General) · page 3:
“NA”
